title: First-run setup — logo position and failure card

steps.headline: The logo is bigger and holds one spot above the middle; the step's content starts a fixed distance below it.
steps.changed: Icon 80 → 112px (the name and tagline scale with it). Before, the logo was centred together with the content, so it jumped whenever a step was taller or shorter. Now it sits at the same height on every step, and the content starts 56px under it.
steps.notice: Moving from step to step, the logo stays still and only the part below it changes.
steps.risk: On a short window, a tall step scrolls rather than squeezing the logo.

steps.headline: Sign-in with the logo in the same fixed spot.
steps.changed: Only the logo's size and position; the three rows are as you approved.
steps.notice: Same logo height as on the install screen.

steps.headline: The square mark and its two lines are centred as one group in the card.
steps.changed: The mark stays left of 'Setup stopped' and the sentence, but the pair now sits in the middle of the card, lined up with Retry and 'Show details'.
steps.notice: Everything in the card shares one centre line.
